nodes.description: External view function randomMod(uint256 seed, uint256 nonce, uint256 mod) returning a keccak256-derived value modulo mod.
tx.origin used as entropy source inside abi.encodePacked; attacker-influenced and controllable.
block.timestamp used as entropy source inside abi.encodePacked; miner/validator influenced.

keccak256(abi.encodePacked(tx.origin, nonce, blockhash(block.number-1), block.timestamp, seed)) % mod: pseudo-randomness derived from predictable/attacker-influenceable on-chain values, and modulo bias.
Input parameter seed, fed into the encoding for the randomness computation.
Input parameter nonce, fed into the encoding for the randomness computation.
Input parameter mod, modulus applied to the hash result.

edges.reason: The randomMod function body executes the keccak256-based modulo computation.
tx.origin is packed into the hash feeding the randomness result, making the output depend on an attacker-controllable origin.
block.timestamp is packed into the hash feeding the randomness result, creating timestamp dependence.
seed parameter flows into the keccak256 preimage of the random value.
nonce parameter flows into the keccak256 preimage of the random value.
mod parameter is used as the divisor of the modulo operation, which can cause modulo bias/revert.

normalization_plan.reason: seed is only a function parameter consumed by randomMod and carries no independent state; merge into the core function node.
nonce is only a function parameter consumed by randomMod and carries no independent state; merge into the core function node.
mod is only a function parameter consumed by randomMod and carries no independent state; merge into the core function node.
